name: fallback404
description: Finds missing 404, loading and error states in a Next.js App Router app, fixes soft 404s, and designs on-brand replacements with you on a picker page.

interface.shortDescription: Find and design the missing 404, loading and error pages of your Next.js app.
interface.longDescription: Scans a Next.js App Router app for missing not-found, loading and error states and for 404 pages that answer HTTP 200, shows them on a picker page, designs on-brand replacements with you and writes them on a new git branch. Nothing is committed.
defaultPrompt: Fix the soft 404s in this app.
Give my dashboard a loading state.
